leadText: A Roller Skater (Japanese: ローラースケート Roller Skate) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VI. They are depicted as teenagers moving around on roller skates and wearing protective equipment. In the Battle Maison, they specialize in - and Pokémon.
plainText:
A Roller Skater (Japanese: ローラースケート Roller Skate) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VI. They are depicted as teenagers moving around on roller skates and wearing protective equipment. In the Battle Maison, they specialize in - and Pokémon.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
In Sylveon Enchants, a Roller Skater was seen in the Mini-game Corner, playing the Tile Puzzle minigame.

Several Roller Skaters appeared in Corphish Pinches at the skating park. They watched and were impressed as performed some tricks with his own roller skates.
 

==In the TCG==
This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Roller Skaters in the Pokémon Trading Card Game. Here, Roller Skaters are spelled as ローラースケーター.
